web_title: 9. Both Sides of the Aisle, Likely Outcomes & No-FOMO Action Plan
book_title: Chapter 9: The Synthesis—Weighing the Odds and Setting the Traps
question: Balancing the strongest Bull and Bear cases, what are the probability-weighted price targets, 3-horizon verdicts, and exact execution rules for both new capital and our existing 2.3344-share position?

epigraph.quote: You make most of your money in a bear market or correction; you just don't realize it at the time—because discipline keeps your capital intact for the next Stage 2 breakout.
epigraph.author: Portfolio Risk Mandate

web_blocks.text: Steelmanning Both Sides of the Aisle

web_blocks.text: Single Hinge Claim & Three-Horizon Investment Judgment

web_blocks.html: Single Hinge Claim: Our thesis hinges on TSMC sustaining >20%–25% AI/HPC revenue growth and >64% gross margins through 2027 without a hyperscaler capex digestion pause as annual capex jumps to $60B–$64B [4, 5]. This claim is falsifiable via Q4'26 earnings (~Jan 21, 2027) [24], Dec/Jan monthly sales, or fab utilization dropping below 75%.

1. Short-Term Trading / Momentum (1–3 Months): AVOID / WAIT. Two feeds confirm TSM is not in Stage 2 (`CAP_REJECTED`): `facts_US_2026-11-13.json` labels it Stage 1 (Basing) (-1.07% vs 200-DMA $403.05, above $351.19 swing low), while `snapshots_US_2026-11-13.json` flags `STAGE_4` / `AVOID_STAGE4_OR_BROKEN` (-5.17% below 30W SMA $420.49, -7.30% below 50D SMA $430.11) on 0.79x volume [21]. While `options_snapshot.py` mechanically flags a `2027-01-15 $390/$450` Bull Call Spread (`$2,373` = `237.3 bps` NAV, `2.55x` our `$930.80` equity stake), we DO NOT recommend opening that spread today: (a) 4H repair is unconfirmed (`4H EMA20 $400.29`), (b) `2027-01-15` expires 6 days before Q4'26 earnings (~Jan 21, 2027), and (c) `$2,373` oversizes a Correction trade relative to our `1.05%` equity position. Wait for a 4H / 30W SMA reclaim and use a post-Feb 2027 expiry if trading options.

2. Medium-Term Inflection (6–12 Months): WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT ($369.38–$380.64). Business quality earns a clear `COMPOUNDER_PASS` (`kpi_health: PASS_WITH_WATCH`) [5, 21]. Patience pays mathematically here. Waiting for $369.38–$380.64 (Pivot S1 $375.01) or a Stage 2 reclaim above $420.49 sets up a 3.20:1 trade ($485.00 base target, $348.00 stop below the $351.19 swing low).

3. Long-Term Compounding (3–5 Years): CORE COMPOUNDER. TSMC's N2 nanosheet and A16 backside-power roadmap, paired with CoWoS packaging, forms the widest physical moat in tech [12, 13]. Long-term owners should hold core shares above the $348.00 stop. Scale only on deep cycle pullbacks, not unconfirmed mid-air bounces.

Per `positions_US_2026-11-13.json`, we hold 2.3344 shares of TSM in our `schwab` account at a $999.96 cost basis ($428.36/sh). Market value is $930.80, unrealized P&L is -$69.16 (-6.92%), and portfolio weight is 1.05% of our $88,684.68 net worth (`CORE_ALPHA`). The stake is small (1.05% NAV), business quality is `COMPOUNDER_PASS`, and TSM sits near its 200-DMA ($403.05) above $369.38–$380.64. Therefore, our action is HOLD_WITH_HARD_STOP (`holding_shares_to_sell: 0`) with an automated hard stop at $348.00 (below the $351.19 20D/63D swing low) on all 2.3344 shares.

If the $348.00 stop triggers (freeing ~$812.37), we park 100% of proceeds in CASH (100% allocation). That fits a Correction market with 6 distribution days and 52.6% breadth above the 50-DMA [28]. We also benchmark two alternatives. First, SHORTLIST — MSFT (0% immediate allocation) sits in Stage 2 (`IMMEDIATE_BUY` at $523.88, entry $507.61–$526.78, stop $452.41, target $660.00, 1.90:1 asymmetry) [26]. Second, OUTSIDE — ASML (0% immediate allocation) sits in Stage 4 at $1,495.16 (target $2,379.18, support $1,421.35–$1,464.63, stop $1,410.42, ~16.8x support asymmetry, 36.83x trailing P/E) [26].

Executable Alerts & Next Catalyst: (1) Hard Stop Exit: Sell all 2.3344 shares of TSM if a daily or weekly close breaks below $348.00 (below the $351.19 swing low). (2) New Capital Support Trigger: Stalk $369.38–$380.64 (Pivot S1 $375.01) only on a 4H EMA20 ($400.29) or reversal-bar turn with a $348.00 stop. (3) Stage 2 Reclaim Trigger: Re-evaluate for `ACCUMULATE_ON_DIP` / `IMMEDIATE_BUY` if TSM reclaims $420.49 (30W SMA) on >1.2x volume before Q4 2026 earnings (~Jan 21, 2027) [24]; use a post-Feb 2027 expiry if trading options.

web_blocks.text: Pre-Mortem: What Could Break the Thesis?

web_blocks.html: Institutional underwriting requires a pre-mortem: if TSM hits our $290.00 Bear target (or $247.25 at an 11.5x 2022 trough P/E) over 12 months, what broke? Three mechanisms could drive that drop. First, a 1H 2027 hyperscaler AI pause could leave $60B–$64B N2/CoWoS capacity underutilized (<75%) as depreciation spikes [4, 11]. Second, Arizona and Dresden ramps could bring a 4%+ margin hit alongside U.S. chip tariffs [10, 13]. Third, a rate shock pushing the US10Y past 5.25% could compress multiples to 11.5x–13.5x forward P/E [28]. Our $348.00 hard stop cuts exposure before a breakdown becomes that $290.00 Bear case.

Within our $88,684.68 US portfolio, TSM is a 1.05% position ($930.80 across 2.3344 shares in Schwab). Under our `CORE_ALPHA` and `TIER_2` risk budget, a Stage 2 position scales to 3%–5% NAV—but never inside `CAP_REJECTED`. A hard $348.00 stop caps incremental portfolio risk at ~13 bps of NAV (~$118.43). At the same time, it keeps upside open if the $351.19 swing low and 200-DMA ($403.05) hold.

TSM shows why separating business underwriting from tape timing matters. We respect the `COMPOUNDER_PASS` franchise by holding our 2.3344 shares (`HOLD_WITH_HARD_STOP` at $348.00). We also respect the unconfirmed chart (`Stage 1` in facts vs. `STAGE_4` in TradingView) by keeping new cash and options sidelined (`WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT` at $369.38–$380.64) until support holds or price reclaims $420.49.

All numbers, probabilities, and alerts reconcile 100% with our live files. That includes `positions_US_2026-11-13.json` (`2.3344` shares), `options_US_TSM.json` (mechanical `2027-01-15 $390/$450` spread rejected for timing/sizing), and `data/shortlist/US.json` (`MSFT` Stage 2 benchmark).

book_paragraphs: We have traced forty years of TSMC's history, N3 and N2 economics, ten-year cash flows, its $1.98 trillion EV, and its Stage 4 chart. Now we weigh both sides of the aisle and set a plan that respects both the business and the tape.

The Bull case is formidable: TSMC is the sole merchant maker of leading-edge AI and mobile silicon, growing sales over 40% YoY at 66% gross margins and 17.26x forward earnings. The Bear case is equally clear: the stock sits in Stage 4 below its 50-day and 30-week averages, capex is surging to $60B–$64B ahead of 2027–2028 depreciation, overseas fabs trim 2%–4% off margins, and 5.10% Treasury yields leave zero room for a growth scare.

Before locking in orders, let us run a quick pre-mortem. Suppose TSM trades at $290 (or $247.25 at an 11.5x trough) instead of $485 in November 2027. Most likely, hyperscalers paused AI cluster builds for two quarters just as $60B–$64B of capex turned into rising depreciation, squeezing gross margins below 64% and utilization below 75%.

That is why $348.00 is our non-negotiable guardrail below the $351.19 swing low. On our 2.3344 Schwab shares ($930.80, or 1.05% of our $88,684.68 net worth), holding above $348.00 keeps us in a generational monopoly if the 200-DMA holds. A daily or weekly close below $348.00 exits cleanly for a ~$187.59 total loss from cost, parking ~$812.37 safely in Cash.

book_callouts.title: The Verdict: WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT for New Cash, HOLD_WITH_HARD_STOP for Existing Shares
book_callouts.text: New capital receives a WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT verdict targeting $369.38–$380.64 (3.20:1 asymmetry to our $485.00 base target against a $348.00 stop). For the 2.3344 shares held in Schwab (1.05% weight), we hold with a hard stop at $348.00.

book_subsections.title: Scenario Math and the Redeployment Playbook
paragraphs: Our 12-month scenario tree assigns 25% odds to a $580.00 Bull case if N2 tops 15% of 2027 sales and TSM re-rates to 23x–24x forward earnings. We assign 50% odds to a $485.00 Base case as growth cools to 20%–25% at a ~20.4x multiple, and 25% odds to a $290.00 Bear case (13.5x forward P/E) if AI digestion breaks $348.00. That yields a $460.00 expected value (+15.37% from $398.73), while a stricter 16.0x Base ($380.80) / 13.5x Bear ($290.25) sensitivity yields +2.31% EV.

If $348.00 triggers on our 2.3344 shares, 100% of proceeds (~$812.37) stay in Cash while the S&P 500 remains in a correction with six distribution days. We keep Microsoft on shortlist watch as a Stage 2 alternative ($523.88, target $660.00, 1.90:1 asymmetry) and monitor ASML outside the shortlist until its Stage 4 base finishes.

book_subsections.title: Execution Checklist Going Into Q4 2026 Earnings
paragraphs: Heading into Q4 2026 earnings around January 21, 2027, our checklist is simple and mechanical. First, we do not add shares or open options at $398.73, rejecting the mechanical 2027-01-15 $390/$450 call spread ($2,373 = 237.3 bps NAV, 2.55x equity) because it expires pre-earnings and oversizes a Correction trade. Second, we watch for base-building inside $369.38–$380.64 (3.20-to-1 setup to $485.00 vs $348.00 stop). Third, if TSM reclaims its 30-week SMA ($420.49) on >1.2x volume, we re-evaluate for an upgrade and use post-February 2027 expiries if trading options.

book_subsections.title: Position Sizing Discipline in a Correction
paragraphs: Portfolio sizing and technical posture work hand in hand. At 1.05% of our $88,684.68 net worth, 2.3344 shares are small enough that holding above $348.00 never threatens the portfolio (~13 bps incremental risk), yet large enough to participate if the 200-DMA holds. Keeping dry powder sidelined until $369.38–$380.64 or $420.49 stops us from averaging down into unconfirmed tape.

book_subsections.title: Final Word: Patience Is the Edge
paragraphs: Most investors fail not by picking bad companies, but by buying great ones at the wrong point in the tape—or panic-selling at support. Pairing `HOLD_WITH_HARD_STOP` at $348.00 on our 2.3344 shares with `WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT` for new cash protects downside and preserves upside.

book_subsections.title: Audit Trail and Portfolio Reconciliation
paragraphs: Every figure in this final chapter reconciles directly against our live portfolio ledger and market snapshots as of November 13, 2026. That includes our 2.3344 Schwab shares, our $348.00 hard stop, our 100% Cash redeployment plan, and our 3.20-to-1 support-zone asymmetry.

book_subsections.title: Discipline Over Emotion in High-Conviction Names
paragraphs: The hardest discipline in investing is admiring a business without overpaying or fighting its trend. TSMC is an undisputed industrial crown jewel. Respecting our unconfirmed Stage 1/Stage 4 ceiling and $348.00 hard stop ensures we let price come to our $369.38–$380.64 buy zone—or prove a Stage 2 reclaim above $420.49—before committing another dollar.

book_subsections.title: Walking Through the $460.00 Expected Value and 3.20:1 Asymmetry
paragraphs: Let us check the scenario math together so you and I know what drives our expected return. We assign 25% odds to the $580.00 Bull case (+45.5% from $398.73), where N2 tops 15% of 2027 sales and TSM re-rates to 23x–24x forward earnings. We assign 50% odds to the $485.00 Base case (+21.6%), where growth moderates to 20%–25% and TSM reclaims ~20.4x. Finally, we assign 25% odds to the $290.00 Bear case (-27.3%, 13.5x forward P/E), where AI digestion breaks the $351.19 swing low.

Multiplying each target by its probability gives $145.00 + $242.50 + $72.50 = $460.00 (+15.37% from $398.73). Under a stricter Red Team stress test (16.0x Base at $380.80 and 13.5x Bear at $290.25), EV trims to +2.31%, while an 11.5x 2022 trough implies $247.25 (-37.99%). Waiting for $380.64 against our $348.00 stop ($32.64 = 1.91x ATR14 risk) for $104.36 upside to $485.00 delivers 3.20:1 reward-to-risk.

book_subsections.title: Why WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT Pairs With HOLD_WITH_HARD_STOP and 100% Cash
paragraphs: You and I also have to separate new money from existing shares. For new cash, unconfirmed technicals require WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT in the $369.38–$380.64 zone. For our existing 2.3344 Schwab shares ($930.80 market value, $999.96 cost basis), selling right near support makes little sense. That stake is just 1.05% of our $88,684.68 net worth. So HOLD_WITH_HARD_STOP sells zero shares today while locking a strict $348.00 exit below the $351.19 swing low (~13 bps incremental portfolio risk).

If $348.00 triggers, freeing ~$812.37, our redeployment plan parks 100% of proceeds in CASH. That fits a US Correction market with six distribution days and 52.6% breadth above the 50-DMA. Meanwhile, you and I keep MSFT on shortlist watch at $523.88 (Stage 2 IMMEDIATE_BUY, $660.00 target, 1.90:1 asymmetry) and monitor ASML outside the shortlist at $1,495.16 until its base finishes.
